Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase. The umpires are out in the middle along with the Ireland players. Chirag Suri and Waseem Muhammad are the openers for United Arab Emirates. Josh Little has the new ball in hand.
... RUN CHASE ...

The bowling from United Arab Emirates was exceptional as they kept things tight and did not give any free runs away. Kashif Daud was decent in his 4 overs but it was the spell of Rohan Mustafa who turned things around. His three wickets in 4 overs was the key in restricting Ireland to a low score and they will be very pleased with the effort. Ahmed Raza was economical as well and overall, it was a very good bowling effort from United Arab Emirates. Will they be able to chase it down? Join us for the chase in a while.

Ireland had a very good start as Kevin O'Brien and Paul Stirling played beautifully. They stitched a wonderful partnership and put Ireland on top. But once Stirling fell, things went awry for them as they kept on losing wicket at regular intervals and could not up the ante. Kevin O'Brien played well for his fifty but Ireland needed him to continue. Andy Balbirnie tried hard but couldn't get the big shots coming and he retired hurt in the last over. All in all, it was a poor batting effort.

An excellent bowling performance from United Arab Emirates! They have done extremely well and they will be pretty pleased with the effort in the field. Now, they have a good chance of winning this. Ireland, on the other hand, will be disappointed with the batting effort and they need a terrific bowling effort to defend this.
Flatter one, cut away towards deep point. They race back for the second and get it easily. Ireland end with 134/5!
Full toss, outside off and carved over point. The ball seems to be racing away into the fence but the fielder from sweeper cover runs around and cuts it off. They take three.
On off and powered down to wide long off for a single.
Full again, on middle. Neil Rock makes room and hammers it towards cover where the fielder bobbles it. They get just a single though.
Full and on off, Singh works it to long on for a run.

Andy Balbirnie is down in some pain. The physios are out and are having a check on him. He seems to be in some serious pain and Andy Balbirnie is walking off the field. Simi Singh is the new batter who will replace Andy Balbirnie.
Balbirnie shuffles across and looks to paddle sweep. Mustafa fires it in full and around off. Balbirnie misses and gets hit full on the toes. He seems to be in some pain.
Rohan Mustafa (3-0-15-3) to bowl the final over.
A length ball, on middle. Andy Balbirnie looks to swing across but gets an inside edge down to short fine leg. They get a run. Just 5 off the penultimate over.
A yorker, on middle and leg. Rock gets an inside edge past the stumps and towards short fine leg. They scamper through for the single.
Full again, on middle and leg. Andy Balbirnie can't get under it and only manages to push it down the ground. Just the single then.
LEG BYE! Khan comes from around the wicket and fires it in at the pads. Rock looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off the pads on the off side and they get a leg bye.
Neil Rock walks out to bat.

OUT! Cleaned up! What a yorker from Zahoor Khan! It's quick and very full, on off. George Dockrell steps out, looking to cream it through covers but the ball sneaks in under his bat and crashes into the off pole on the full. Ireland lose yert another wicket and Zahoor Khan gets his first wicket.
Full and straight, drilled to long on for a run. The boundaries are hard to come by at the moment for Ireland.
Very full, on middle. Andy Balbirnie heaves it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and wide, squeezed through the point region for another single.
Fuller one, on off and pushed through cover-point for a run.
A length ball, outside off and slashed towards sweeper cover. They race back for the second and the throw is good. The bails are whipped off but George Dockrell is well in. Good running.
On off and driven to short cover.

OUT! CAUGHT! Banged into the deck and Curtis Campher decides to take it on. Campher pulls it but it goes high and towards deep mid-wicket. Waseem Muhammad settles under it and takes a fine catch at the mid-wicket fence. Kashif Daud gets the breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Waseem Muhammad b Kashif Daud

Commentary.Commentary: George Dockrell is the new batsman in.
WIDE! Attempted slower bouncer, way outside the off stump. Wided!
Kashif Daud comes back on.
Back of a length, around off. Campher guides it nicely to third man and picks up a run.
Another slower short ball. This time Balbirnie pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gets a single.
Excellent bowling! Andy Balbirnie shuffles across and Khan bangs in a slower bumper, around off. Balbirnie looks to pull but is beaten by the lack of pace.
Fullish ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie thrashes it through covers but Chirag Suri does get a hand on it which slows down the ball. They get a brace though.
Good-length ball, around off and this one zips through. Andy Balbirnie looks to cut but is beaten by the pace.
Zahoor Khan comes back into the attack. His figures read 2-0-10-0, so far.
Swing and a miss. A length ball, outside off and Andy Balbirnie completely misses it.
Quicker one, on the stumps and eased down the ground for a run.
Tossed up, on middle again. Campher swipes across uppishly and gets it to deep mid-wicket. They get a single.
Gutsy from Curtis Campher. On middle and Campher plays the reverse paddle straightaway. He gets it past short third man and picks up a boundary.
Curtis Campher walks out to bat at No.5.

OUT! BOWLED! Rohan Mustafa is having a ball out there today. Full and straight, you miss and I hit stuff. Kevin O'Brien makes room and looks to go over covers. The ball skids on and Kevin O'Brien misses the ball completely. The ball crashes into middle stump and it's all going downhill for Ireland at the moment.
Flatter one, on middle. Andy Balbirnie punches it down the ground for a run.
On middle and hammered down to long on for a single.
Short and on off, Kevin O'Brien works it off the back foot to long on for a single.
Tosses it up, on middle. Andy Balbirnie sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
Loopy ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie looks to sweep. He is too early into his shot and the ball goes off the toe-end of the bat back to the bowler.
Flighted ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie drills it to long off for a brace. 100 up for Ireland!
On off, pushed to covers for a single.
FIFTY! Loopy ball, outside off. Kevin O'Brien rocks back and cuts it towards sweeper cover for a couple of runs. He brings up his fifty as well.
Karthik Meiyappan (2-0-24-0) comes back into the attack.
Outside off, Andy Balbirnie pushes the ball back to the bowler.
The skipper, Andy Balbirnie is at the crease now.

OUT! BOWLED! Full and on off, Gareth Delany makes room for himself and looks to push it on the off side. He exposes his stumps. The ball is rather too quick for him and it sneaks through his bat. The stumps behind gets disturbed and Rohan Mustafa is the man yet again, who provides the breakthrough.
On off, pushed to covers for a single. Kevin O'Brien moves onto 49.
Short and outside off, Gareth Delany steers it to backward point for one.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Slower through the air, on off. Kevin O'Brien chips it to long off for a single.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Kevin O'Brien leaves it alone. Wided.
Full and on middle, Gareth Delany pushes it to extra cover. There is a misfield that allows the batters to come back for the second run. Ahmed Raza is not happy at all.
Flighted ball on off, Kevin O'Brien guides it to third man for a single.
Short and outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a brace.
Loopy ball, outside off, turning away. Kevin O'Brien makes room for himself and tries to lift it over extra cover but misses.
Outside off, Gareth Delany tucks it to square leg for one.
An arm ball, outside off. Kevin O'Brien crunches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Full again, on middle and leg. Gareth Delany digs it back to the bowler.
Full and on off, pushed to covers.
On middle, this is worked to covers.
Gareth Delany comes in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Rohan Mustafa draws first blood. Loopy ball, on off. Paul Stirling smashes it hard back to the bowler. Rohan Mustafa's hand comes out of nowhere and plucks the ball out of thin air. The ball did pop out of his hand in the first attempt, but Rohan Mustafa is aware and grabs it on the second attempt. Paul Stirling walks back to the pavilion after a fine knock.
Floats it up, on middle and leg. Paul Stirling sweeps it towards fine leg. Muhammad Usman from deep square leg runs to his right and drags the ball back in with his legs. Keeps it down to two.
Full and on leg, drilled to long off for an easy single.
Rohan Mustafa comes into the attack for the first time today.
Short and on middle, Paul Stirling advances down the track and gets hit on the body.
An arm ball, on middle and leg. Kevin O'Brien pushes it uppishly to mid on for a single.
Tosses it up, outside off. Kevin O'Brien dabs it down to the third man region for a couple of runs.
Outside off, worked to long off for one.

Loopy ball on middle, Paul Stirling gets on one knee and launches it towards long on. Basil Hameed there takes a leap and catches the ball. He realizes that he will go over the ropes, so he throws the ball back inside the ring. Saves 4 runs for his team. A brilliant effort from Basil Hameed.
Flatter ball, on leg. Paul Stirling looks to hit it on the leg side. He misses and gets hit on the pads.
Shortish ball, outside off. Kevin O'Brien looks to cut but gets an outside edge. The ball goes on the bounce to backward point. 13 off the over and this partnership is hurting UAE a lot now.
SIX! Clean as a whistle! Flighted delivery, on middle. Kevin O'Brien stands tall and smokes it right back over the bowler's head for a maximum. He looks in good knick now.
WIDE! Quicker one, way down the leg side. Good take from the keeper and a wide is signalled.
Tossed up, around off. Paul Stirling gets on one knee and drags it to wide long on for a single.
It's the googly now. Kevin O'Brien pushes it back towards the bowler off the inner half of the bat. Karthik Meiyappan fails to collect the ball cleanly and they get a single.
On off and cut away to backward point.
FOUR! Dragged down, outside off. Kevin O'Brien makes some room and lifts it over cover-point. The ball beats the fielder in the deep and runs away into the fence.
Shortish ball, around off. Kevin O'Brien rocks back and cuts it hard to deep point for another one.
Flatter one, on off and tapped towards cover.
On off and Stirling gets it to long on and picks up a run.
Short, around off and O'Brien plays it to sweeper cover for a single.
The arm ball now, on off and going on with the angle. Paul Stirling looks to work it on the leg side but gets squared up. The ball goes off the inside edge towards short third man. They get one.
On middle and leg, Kevin O'Brien eases it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Flatter delivery, thumped down to long off for a single.
SIX! WOW! Kevin O'Brien goes big! Tossed up, outside off stump. Kevin O'Brien gives himself room and launches this one over the infield. He clears the wide long off fence with ease.
Slower and looped up, outside off. Kevin O'Brien slices it towards point.
Nicely tossed up, on off. Kevin O'Brien launches it over extra cover and gets a brace. 50 up for Ireland now.
A touch short and wide, Stirling taps it through the cover region for a single.
Loopy ball, around off. Kevin O'Brien caresses it to sweeper cover for one.
Karthik Meiyappan comes into the attack.
On middle and leg, nudged towards mid-wicket for a run. Six singles off the over.
Flatter delivery, on off stump. Stirling rocks back and works it on the off side for yet another single.
Flighted ball, on off. Kevin O'Brien pushes it down the ground for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Paul Stirling punches it off the front foot on the off side for another one.
On off, Kevin O'Brien eases it past extra cover for a single.
Flatter one, around off. This is punched away to sweeper cover for one.
Ahmed Raza to roll his arm now. He replaces Kashif Daud.
Good-length ball, angled into the body. Stirling taps it to cover-point for a quick single. Ireland are 41/0 at the end of the Powerplay.
Back of a length, on off and angling in. Paul Stirling punches it off the back foot to cover-point.
Banged into the pitch and Kevin O'Brien pulls it down to deep square leg for a single.
A slower, short one, down the leg side. Kevin O'Brien misses out on a freebie as he toe-ends it back to the keeper.
Good-length ball, around off. Stirling guides it towards backward point for a single.
Paul Stirling shuffles across his stumps and Khan fires in a length ball at the bodyline. Stirling almost gets cut in half as he looks to block.
On a length, outside off. Paul Stirling guides it to sweeper cover for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Paul Stirling steers it through cover-point for a couple of runs.
Length ball, on middle, Paul Stirling defends it out.
Length ball, on middle. Kevin O'Brien works it to mid on for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Had there been a direct hit, Kevin O'Brien was a goner.
On middle, knocked to mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Deft touch! Short of a length, on off. Paul Stirling steps out and taps it through point for a boundary.
Slower delivery again, on leg. Paul Stirling nudges it to mid-wicket. He retains the strike by picking up a single.
Good-length ball, on middle. Paul Stirling covers the sticks and pats the ball back to the bowler.
On middle, Paul Stirling nudges it to mid-wicket without any fuss.
Slower delivery, on the pads. Kevin O'Brien tickles it short fine leg for one. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end and scores a direct hit but Kevin O'Brien was well inside the crease.
Edged but safe! Good-length ball, on off. Paul Stirling looks to defend. The ball goes off the outside edge to third man for one.
FOUR! Edgy boundary but Paul Stirling won't mind. A length ball, outside off. Paul Stirling throws his hands at it and gets an outside edge. The ball races away into the third man fence.
Here comes the first change. Zahoor Khan comes in to bowl now.
On a length on off, tucked on the leg side.
Short of a length, outside off. Kevin O'Brien carves it towards deep point for a couple of runs.
Fuller in length, on off. Paul Stirling taps it in front of cover for a quick single.
On off, pushed to mid off.
On the pads and this flicked to the left of fine leg. The fielder dives and gets a hand on the ball. Keeps it just to a single.
A length ball, on middle and angling in. O'Brien looks to flick on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The bowler appeals but turned down.
On the pads, Kevin O'Brien flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Good-length ball, in the corridor of uncertainty. Kevin O'Brien pushes it to point.
On a length, on off. Paul Stirling guides it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Short of a length on middle, Paul Stirling this time, hammers it over mid on off the back foot for a boundary.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Good-length ball, on off. Paul Stirling stands tall and drives it through covers. Nobody moves and the ball races away to the boundary.
Length ball, around off. Kevin O'Brien looks to push it on the off side. He gets an inside edge and the ball rolls to square leg. The batters cross ends.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's going to be Akif Raja.

Short of a length, outside off. Kevin O'Brien rocks back and smashes it through covers. The outfield is not that fast and prevents the ball from reaching the boundary. Three runs taken. 7 runs from the first over.
Length ball, outside off. Paul Stirling drives it to point for a single.
Good-length ball, nipping back in, on middle. Paul Stirling blocks it out.
Length ball on middle, Kevin O'Brien plays it to mid on for a single.

Huge appeal for caught behind but turned down! Good-length ball, around off, nipping away. Kevin O'Brien looks to drive but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge and carries through to the keeper. Kashif Daud appeals for caught behind but the umpire shakes his head.
WIDE! Length ball, swinging way down the leg side. Kevin O'Brien leaves it alone. Wided.
Good-length ball, on middle. Paul Stirling tucks it to mid-wicket. He is off the mark with a single.
We are all set to begin! The UAE players make their way out to the middle, followed by Kevin O'Brien and Paul Stirling. Kashif Daud will start with the ball.

United Arab Emirates (Playing XI) - Waseem Muhammad, Chirag Suri, Karthik Meiyappan, Vriitya Aravind (WK), Muhammad Usman, Akif Raja, Kashif Daud, Ahmed Raza (C), Basil Hameed, Rohan Mustafa (In for Alishan Sharafu), Zahoor Khan.

Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Kevin O'Brien, Andy Balbirnie (C), Gareth Delany, George Dockrell, Neil Rock (WK), Curtis Campher, Craig Young, Josh Little, Benjamin White (In place of Mark Adair), Simi Singh.
TOSS - United Arab Emirates have won the toss and they will BOWL first.

United Arab Emirates and Ireland will lock horns with each other in Match 6 of the UAE T20 Summer Bash. Ireland emerged triumph against them earlier however, UAE bounced back and won against them and displayed a clinical performance in their last encounter. In the third T20I, United Arab Emirates set a target of 164 for Ireland and then exuded a severe bowling performance, owing to which Ireland wrapped up for just 109. Coming into this match, both teams will look to bring their 'A' game and win the match. So who will it be? We shall find out. On that note, welcome to the coverage.
... MATCH DAY ...
